inputs.share_count_basis: 492,000,000 issued less 63,419,551 treasury = 428,580,449 at 2026-09-30 (4684.T_HalfYear_H1-FY2027.txt:76-77); post 5-for-1 split of 2024-10-01. No dilutive securities exist, so diluted = basic. Held FLAT (annual_share_growth_pct 0): no SBC to dilute, and ongoing buybacks are treated as value-neutral capital return rather than a modelled count reduction.
inputs.wacc_rationale: JPY-built. 10y JGB ~1.7% + ERP 5.5% x beta ~0.85 (defensive, zero-debt, domestic recurring-revenue software) = CoE ~6.4%; rounded UP to 7.0% to recognise the long duration of a 20x-capped terminal and the project's preference for conservatism. No debt in the capital structure, so WACC = cost of equity. No small-cap premium: OBIC is a ~JPY2.6tn TSE Prime constituent. The house 9% JPY reference is for cyclical keiretsu industrials and does not apply to a 65%-margin, 32-year-consecutive-growth ERP vendor. Same WACC in all three scenarios -- risk is charged once, in the flows.
inputs.lease_treatment: None required: J-GAAP filer, operating leases already expensed in operating income; no lease liabilities on the balance sheet (4684.T_HalfYear_H1-FY2027.txt:252-266). Total debt = 0.
inputs.nci_treatment: No non-controlling interests (純資産 has no 非支配株主持分 line); consolidated flows are 100% attributable.
inputs.working_capital_note: wc_capture 0%: receivables/contract assets (¥21.5bn) exceed payables + deferred income (¥8.6bn), so growth consumes a little cash, but the FY2026 net WC movement was only ~¥0.9bn on ¥14bn of revenue growth. Modelled as neutral; a -5% capture would be worth ~¥20/share.
inputs.tax_note: Cash tax rate 30.5% on EBIT (statutory ~30.6% incl. local taxes). FY2026 cash tax paid ¥27,363m on pre-tax ¥104,744m = 26.1% only because dividend income and equity-method income are largely exempt; on operating EBIT alone the cash rate is ~30%.
inputs.calibration: FY0 component build: revenue 135,209 x (67.7% EBITDA - 2.0% D&A) = EBIT 88,823 (= reported operating income) x (1-30.5%) = NOPAT 61,732 + D&A 2,695 - capex 2,219 = 62,208 vs actual owner FCF 63,295 (difference = +¥0.9bn working-capital inflow). Ties within 2%.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (dcf-methods routing: operating company, non-US -> owner-fcf.md + owner-fcf-adaptations.md). Fresh build, no prior DCF. SBC-zero market: house and street bases coincide, band_position is null. Excluded-income / matching-asset rule applied: all cash interest and dividends received (¥8.2bn) stripped from the FCF base, and the ¥336.6bn investment-securities portfolio (AFS at fair value plus the OBIC Business Consultants 4733.T equity-method stake at ¥64.5bn book) added back in equity_bridge net of the ¥60.1bn deferred-tax liability on unrealised gains. The OBC stake is listed and its market value is well above book -- that upside is deliberately NOT modelled (stake percentage is not disclosed in the tanshin). Terminal cap 20x binds in base and bull at 7% WACC (Gordon at g=2% would be 20.4x). Price is the Friday 2026-10-30 TSE close; not an after-hours print.

equity_bridge.note: 投資有価証券 ¥336,589m at 2026-09-30 (4684.T_HalfYear_H1-FY2027.txt:234; AFS at fair value incl. OBC 4733.T equity-method stake at ¥64.5bn book) less 繰延税金負債 ¥60,140m (line 261). Matching asset for the ¥8.2bn/yr interest+dividend income stripped from the flows.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_5yr_cagr (owner-FCF 5yr CAGR 10.4% agrees); year-1 anchored to FY2027 guidance of +11.8%
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (16.3% / 14.2%) exceeds revenue CAGR (10.5% / 10.0%) by >30% because book equity is inflated by ¥145bn of unrealised gains on the investment-securities portfolio (その他有価証券評価差額金), not by operating retention; it is NOT used as the growth anchor. EPS CAGR (~15%) exceeds revenue CAGR by ~5pp from margin expansion (OI margin 60.0% FY2021 -> 65.7% FY2026) and a ~3.7% lower share count -- both captured in the component paths, not extrapolated.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF less cash interest and dividends received (FY2017 ¥18.9bn, FY2021 ¥38.6bn, FY2023 ¥47.5bn, FY2026 ¥63.3bn). Owner-FCF CAGR (10.0% / 10.4%) runs ~1.3-1.6pp below reported FCF CAGR (11.3% / 12.0%): the gap is the growing dividend stream from the securities portfolio, which is valued as an asset in the bridge rather than as growth. FY2017-FY2020 FCF was depressed by a ¥30bn HQ/data-centre build (capex ¥7-12.5bn/yr); FY2021 onward is the clean run-rate.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 = FY2027 guidance +11.8% (raised 2026-10-27; H1 ran +14.0%, so guidance is not stretched). Then decelerates ~1pp/yr from the 10% five-year run-rate toward Japanese nominal GDP as the domestic mid-market ERP opportunity matures. 10-yr compound ~6.6%.
base.margin_rationale: FY2027 guidance implies OI margin 66.5% (+0.8pp) = ~68.5% EBITDA; path tops out at 69.0% as the ~74%-margin System Support mix keeps rising but wage inflation and cloud opex cap the gain. No peak-margin extrapolation beyond +1.3pp.
base.capex_rationale: 2.5% of revenue, above D&A (2.0%) and the FY2021-26 average (1.9%) to fund stated cloud data-centre capacity investment; well below the FY2018-20 build years (9-15%).

scenario_narratives.base: OBIC delivers FY2027 guidance (+11.8% revenue, 66.5% OI margin) on the back of double-digit order growth in all three segments, then decelerates gradually as the Japan-only mid-market ERP pool matures: 10% -> 5% by year 7 -> 2.5% by year 10. The System Support (cloud/maintenance, ~53% of revenue, ~74% segment margin) mix shift lifts EBITDA margin ~1.3pp to 69% and no further; wage inflation in a tight engineering labour market and cloud opex absorb the rest. Capex runs modestly above D&A for data-centre capacity. The ¥483bn of cash and securities is treated as a separable asset, not an engine of growth. Terminal value capped at 20x owner FCF (Gordon at 7%/2% would be 20.4x).
scenario_narratives.bull: Large-enterprise wins (>¥100bn-revenue customers, flagged as accelerating in FY2026) and AI-enabled modules (management-analytics, decision-support, input-assist AI) lift ARPU and win rates, so growth holds 10%+ for five years (H1 FY2027 +14% becomes the run-rate rather than a peak) and the mix shift plus AI-driven internal productivity push EBITDA margin to 70.5%. Capex stays at the lean 2.2% the business has historically needed. Terminal growth 2.5%. Even here the exit is capped at 20x FCF, well below the ~37x the market pays today.
scenario_narratives.bear: The two-sided squeeze materialises: SAP/Oracle hold the large-enterprise tier and cloud-native vendors (Money Forward, freee) push up from the SMB end, while Japan's shrinking graduate pool constrains the headcount-led delivery model. Growth fades to 2% by year 7 and the operating margin gives back ~5pp (EBITDA 63%) as pricing pressure meets wage inflation and higher cloud capex (3%). Terminal growth 1.5% and a 18x cap. No solvency dimension -- zero debt and ¥480bn of liquid assets -- so this is a de-rating case, not a distress case.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Base 55%: 32 consecutive years of operating-income growth and a mid-year guidance raise make the guidance-anchored path the most likely. Bull trimmed to 25% from the 35% default because it requires several independent things to persist for a decade -- large-enterprise share gains against SAP/Oracle, AI monetisation and a sustained hiring pipeline -- in a 100% Japan-domestic market. Bear raised to 20% from 15% for the structural two-sided competitive squeeze and demographic headwind, but no higher: the balance sheet carries no debt or going-concern dimension.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A debt-free, 65%-margin domestic compounder valued on owner FCF with its cash and securities portfolio added as a separable asset. The model deliberately refuses to extrapolate the FY2027 acceleration (+14% H1) or the ~37x FCF multiple the market pays: growth decays to GDP within a decade, the terminal exit is capped at 20x, and the ¥145bn of unrealised securities gains is taken net of tax. Risk is carried in the scenario flows at a single 7% JPY cost of equity, not stacked into the discount rate.
key_risks_to_valuation: Terminal-heavy: with growth decaying to 2.5% and a 20x cap, roughly two-thirds of enterprise value sits in the terminal; each 1pp of WACC is worth roughly 15% of value.
Japan-only addressable market: if mid-market ERP saturation arrives sooner than the ~7-year deceleration assumed, the base case overstates value.
Investment-securities portfolio (¥337bn, >50% of total assets) is marked to market; a Japanese equity drawdown reduces the ¥276bn bridge item roughly one-for-one after tax.
Upside not modelled: the listed OBC (4733.T) equity-method stake is carried at ¥64.5bn book, materially below market value; the stake percentage is not disclosed in the tanshin so it is left at book.
Labour-constrained delivery model: a new-graduate hiring shortfall would cap System Integration capacity regardless of demand.
